title: From Doyle to AGM: A Survey and an Implementation Roadmap for Belief Change
abstract: arXiv:2608.14567v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: This paper presents a targeted narrative review establishing the historical and theoretical foundations for computational belief change implementation. Seeded by Doyle and London's foundational 1980 taxonomy, we trace the evolution of belief revision from computational origins through the theoretical transformation of the AGM framework to contemporary approaches. Our analysis demonstrates how pre-AGM computational pragmatism relates to AGM theoretical constructs, revealing both continuities and transformations across this evolution. We analyze how each taxonomical category evolved in the post-AGM era, identifying the theoretical foundations and historical precedents that inform contemporary implementation challenges. This foundation enables subsequent research into robust computational blueprints that synthesize historical insights with formal guarantees, providing the baseline for systematic implementation analysis and engineering-focus

translated_title: 从多伊尔到AGM：信念变更的综述与实施路线图
translated_abstract: 本文呈现了一篇有针对性的叙事性综述，为计算信念变更实施建立了历史和理论基础。以多伊尔和伦敦1980年的基础性分类为起点，我们追溯了信念修正从计算起源，经过AGM框架的理论转型，到当代方法的演变过程。我们的分析展示了前AGM计算实用主义与AGM理论构建之间的关系，揭示了这一演变过程中的连续性与转变。我们分析了每个分类类别在AGM后时代如何演变，识别了为当代实施挑战提供信息的理论基础和历史先例。这一基础为后续研究提供了支撑，使得能够构建综合历史洞见与形式保证的健壮计算蓝图，为系统性实施分析和工程导向提供基线。
tldr: 本文通过综述从多伊尔到AGM的信念变更理论演变，揭示了前AGM实用主义与AGM理论构建的关联，为计算信念变更的实施提供了历史基础和路线图。
en_tdlr: This paper surveys the evolution of belief change from Doyle to AGM, revealing the connections between pre-AGM pragmatism and AGM theoretical constructs, providing a historical foundation and roadmap for computational belief change implementation.
